subject: Digital Electronics
questionText:
Which of the following is true?
(a)
% resolution of DAC changes with change in
reference voltage.
(b)
% resolution decreases as reference voltage
decreases.
(c)
% resolution decreases as number of bits
decreases.
(d) % resolution increases as number of bits
decreases.
